title: Diabetes mellitus: type, complications and medication status
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM codes for the patient's diabetes, its complications and related long-term drug use.
note:
Chief Complaint
"Follow-up for established chronic conditions."

History of Present Illness
The patient presents for routine follow-up. He has a history of type 1 diabetes mellitus, managed with long-term insulin. He also has a diagnosis of CKD stage 4. During today's visit, the provider reiterated that the current status of the CKD stage 4 is unrelated to diabetes. He continues to use insulin for management of his type 1 diabetes.

Medication List
Insulin (specific regimen details omitted)

Exam
Vitals are stable. General exam is unremarkable. Cardiovascular and pulmonary exams are within normal limits.

Assessment
1. Type 1 diabetes mellitus: Stable on long-term insulin.
2. CKD stage 4: Stable; provider confirms this condition is unrelated to diabetes.

Plan
Continue current insulin regimen for type 1 diabetes. Follow up with primary care in three months. Continue monitoring of CKD stage 4.
explanations: The provider states the CKD is not due to diabetes: code each separately.
Code also the CKD stage (N18.4) as instructed at the diabetes CKD code or separately when unrelated.
Do not assign Z79.4 for type 1 diabetes; insulin use is inherent.

distractors.why: Provider documentation of no link overrides the presumption.
The stage of CKD must be reported with N18.-.
Z79.4 is not assigned for type 1 diabetes.
